description: Work with EPSS, the Exploit Prediction Scoring System published by FIRST: a daily estimate, for every CVE, of how likely it is to be exploited in the wild in the next 30 days. Feed it a scanner export or a ticket queue and get the findings back ranked by real-world risk instead of by severity, watch a CVE's score climb as exploit code appears, see the highest-risk CVEs of the week, and export any of it as CSV. No account or API key required.
